subject: Zac Bears Candidate Presentation
overview: City Council candidate Zac Bears presented his platform during an election event, outlining priorities for housing, education, and infrastructure. No legislative actions were taken during this presentation.

items.title: Candidate Presentation: Zac Bears
items.summary: Candidate Zac Bears proposed a five-year master plan for housing and development to ensure the city remains affordable for working-class residents. His platform also included calls for a city council subcommittee on education, infrastructure improvements to increase walkability in city squares, and a charter review to implement ward representation.
